_comment: Google Play listing images. Each slide is one current design screen (design/canvas.html) in a phone with a headline. English only for now; no Gurbani in any caption (CLAUDE.md rule 3). The screens show what the app does, so a slide whose screen is superseded on the canvas must be changed with it.

slides.title: Mark your Hazri to Waheguru, every day

slides.title: Your whole Nitnem, from Amrit Vela to night

slides.title: Sit in Simran with the sangat of the world

slides.title: Do paath together as a sangat

slides.title: Saakhis to read and listen to together
slides.sub: Illustrated stories, narrated in Punjabi, for every age.

slides.sub: The Gurus, Gurdwaras, banis and Sikh history, five questions at a time.
